risk_if_not_implemented: Without Virtual Machine Images, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3), Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Baseline Configurations
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, document and maintain secure baseline configurations for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Baseline Configurations (CFG-04) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Virtual Machine Images (SEA-23.1) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Configuration Change Control
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to govern the technical configuration change control processes.
compensating_control_2.justification: Configuration Change Control (CHG-03) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Virtual Machine Images (SEA-23.1) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
